research_status: US-only adaptive additional exploration after viewing original global research results. The historical August-September holdout is reused, not independent validation. Candidate selection remains January-May training and June-July validation only.

selection_rule.objective_in_each_scenario: compound log return minus 0.5 * absolute max drawdown
selection_rule.robust_objective: minimum objective across the two execution scenarios
selection_rule.eligible: training max drawdown strictly above -50% in EACH scenario
selection_rule.shortlist: top 1% of training-eligible parameter rows within each scope, ceiling rounding
selection_rule.selection: highest worst-scenario validation objective within the frozen shortlist
selection_rule.mixed_definition: 0 < TIME signal mixture < 1; does not guarantee holdings sourced from both funds

benchmark_policy: Both scenarios compare to the original direct ETF buy-and-hold path, 15 bps initial entry cost and no extra delay. The stressed strategy receives no easier delayed or higher-cost benchmark. Full-period 2x/3x counts use the stronger of the two original ETF cumulative profit rates, positive only.
fresh_holdout_policy: Start cash on the first available August valuation date, earn no stock return before same-date close entry, use each scenario rule and cost. Fresh ETF benchmarks enter at the same date close with 15 bps cost and no delay.
parameter_count_note: Correlated parameter rows with duplicate trajectories; not independent trials
assumptions: Fees/slippage allowances are scenario assumptions; taxes and dividends are excluded
segment_basis: Continuing original portfolios; fresh-cash holdout is separately simulated
limitations: Adaptive exploration designed after the initial August-September holdout was viewed. Not independent validation; reported holdout is reused historical data. No candidate is optimized on holdout returns in this second-stage selection.
Scenario robustness is not protection against researcher selection bias.
Neither scenario establishes historical publication time of backfilled disclosures.
Eight-plus-month sample does not establish performance over a full bull/bear cycle.
US stock/FX daily closes are not synchronized executable quotations.
Maximum stock count is a cap, not a guarantee of diversification or minimum holdings.
execution_calendar: actual QQQ observed US sessions; legacy extra_global_session_lag means US sessions here
